strings.Авторское учебное изложение проверенных: Author's training summary of verified provisions, not a website facsimile
strings.В исходных историях про люк владелец сет: In the original manhole stories, the network owner is unknown; in the river stories, one photograph establishes neither pollution composition nor the supervision level. Assumptions cannot replace missing facts.
strings.В учебном деле есть три письменных ответ: The training case contains three written substantive responses from the same authority. Comparison confirms that the new letter repeats the same issue without new arguments or circumstances. No decision to end correspondence has yet been made. You prepare materials for the manager rather than making that decision yourself.
strings.Все три ответа получены из того же орган: All three responses came from the same authority. I attached copies.
strings.Вымышленные служебные материалы симулято: Fictional official materials of the simulator
strings.Выполняйте действия в пределах своей рол: Act within your role. Independent actions may be performed in different orders.
strings.Выслушайте обращение и уточните факты. Н: Listen to the appeal and clarify the facts. The case title does not determine which actions are correct.
strings.Для решения о прекращении переписки учит: A decision to end correspondence takes account of repeated prior substantive replies, absence of new arguments or circumstances, and statutory conditions. Letter count alone is insufficient.
strings.Для сверки доступны ответы одного органа: Responses from one authority are available for comparison.
strings.Для уже опубликованной информации допуст: For information already published, a reply may identify the publication or the official website address where it appears. Verify that the requested information is actually on that official website. A direct link is more convenient, but is not itself the only format permitted by law.
strings.Если решение вопросов не относится к ком: If the issues lie outside the recipient's powers, the written appeal is forwarded to the competent body or official and the citizen is notified. An address does not establish authority.
strings.Жалобу нельзя направить на рассмотрение: A complaint must not be referred for consideration to the body or official whose decision, action or inaction is challenged.
strings.Заблокировать любые последующие обращени: Block every subsequent appeal from this citizen
strings.Закон предоставляет уполномоченному лицу: The law gives the authorised official the right to decide when the combined conditions are met; a registration employee cannot replace that decision with a letter counter.
strings.Запретить гражданину впредь направлять л: Forbid the citizen from submitting any future appeals.
strings.Запрос информации о деятельности власти: A request for information on public-authority activities
strings.Запрос информации рассматривается по спе: An information request follows special rules. If the information does not concern the recipient's activities, apply referral to the competent body with notification to the user.
strings.Зарегистрировать и оценить новое сообщен: Register and assess the new report; the earlier decision concerns a defined issue and does not replace examination of new circumstances.
strings.Зарегистрировать материал и представить: Register the material and present the comparison to the authorised official for a decision on further consideration or ending correspondence on this issue.
strings.Какие новые обстоятельства вы сообщаете?: What new circumstances are you reporting?
strings.Количество писем автоматически заменяет: The number of letters automatically replaces a decision by the head.
strings.Любое изменение даты письма всегда являе: Any change in a letter’s date is always a new material circumstance.
strings.Любой сотрудник обязан автоматически пре: Every employee must automatically end correspondence after the fourth letter.
strings.Материалы дела · реестр и ответ исполнит: Case materials · register and contractor's reply
strings.Материалы одного органа: три прежних пис: Materials from one authority: three earlier written substantive responses to the same issue, followed by a fourth letter. No new arguments or circumstances. Comparison is complete; their presence is not disputed in this exercise.
strings.Найдите норму и проверьте её применимост: Find the provision and check its applicability. A source page does not replace justification of the decision.
strings.Найдите условия прекращения переписки по: Find the conditions for ending correspondence on repeated appeals.
strings.Найдите часть статьи 11, которая определ: Find the part of Article 11 that sets the conditions for ending correspondence. Check whether the head's right becomes an automatic obligation for a reception employee.
strings.Наличие письменного решения ещё нужно пр: A written decision still needs to be checked; it does not arise automatically.
strings.Не регистрировать материал и не сохранят: Do not register the material or retain earlier responses.
strings.Нет. В имеющихся ответах такого решения: No. The responses I have contain no such decision.
strings.Новое письмо поступило, регистрация ещё: The new letter has arrived but is not registered. Calculate the final registration day, not the deadline for deciding to end correspondence.
strings.Новый документ или снимок сопоставляют с: Compare a new document or photograph with the subject and date of the old reply. The same letter writer does not prove the issues are identical.
strings.Новых обстоятельств нет. Прошу ещё раз п: There are no new circumstances. I ask you to reconsider the same arguments; I did not alter the date on the old photograph.
strings.Номер части статьи 11 об условиях прекра: Number of the part of Article 11 on the conditions for ending correspondence
strings.Нужно различать наличие основания, полно: Distinguish the existence of grounds, the power to decide and notification of the adopted decision.
strings.Обеспечить уведомление гражданина, если: Ensure the citizen is notified if the authorised official decides to end correspondence
strings.Общий срок рассмотрения письменного обра: The general written-appeal consideration period is tied to registration. It is not a universal deadline for construction, repairs or pollution removal.
strings.Орган обеспечивает объективное, всесторо: The body ensures objective, comprehensive and timely consideration, requests materials where needed and provides a substantive reply. An appeal does not replace a budget decision.
strings.Орган определяет подразделение или должн: The body designates the unit or officials responsible for information access. Publishing a law on a ministry website does not mean that ministry holds every requested local document.
strings.Письмо поступило {{received}}. Автор пов: The letter arrived on {{received}}. The author repeats the earlier arguments and attaches the same photographs. It has a signature and a reply address.
strings.Пишу снова про те же светильники. Новых: I am writing again about the same lights. I have no new photographs, but I disagree with the earlier responses. The reception office said that because this is my fourth letter, it can be deleted immediately.
strings.По условиям дела новых доводов или обсто: The case conditions provide no new arguments or circumstances.
strings.Подтвердить совпадение вопроса и отсутст: Confirm the same issue and absence of new arguments from the materials
strings.Получали ли вы уведомление о прекращении: Have you received a notice ending correspondence?
strings.Помощник: «Если условия части 5 статьи 1: Assistant: “If Part 5 of Article 11’s conditions are met, the registration employee must independently end correspondence.”
strings.После решения руководителя о прекращении: After the manager ends correspondence on the old issue, the same citizen reports newly damaged support equipment at another site. The new photograph and location were absent from the earlier materials.
strings.Правило исчисления в этом учебном деле:: Calculation rule for this training case: exclude the triggering day. Count all calendar days; if the end falls on a non-working day, move it to the next working day. This profile is specified by the scenario and does not automatically apply to every procedure.
strings.Предложен общий запрет на обращения вмес: A blanket ban on appeals has been proposed instead of a decision on a specific issue.
strings.Представить руководителю основания и пре: Present the grounds and limits of a possible decision to the manager
strings.Прекратить переписку самостоятельно толь: Independently end correspondence based only on the letter’s sequence number
strings.Прекращение переписки даёт запрет на люб: Ending correspondence prohibits any future questions.
strings.Прекращение переписки по прежнему вопрос: Ending correspondence on the old issue is not a permanent ban on other appeals or new circumstances.
strings.При выполнении совокупности условий упол: When the combined conditions are met, the authorised official may decide to end correspondence on the issue, notifying the citizen.
strings.При нескольких вопросах, относящихся к р: Where several issues belong to different bodies, copies of the appeal are forwarded to the appropriate recipients. Keep the issues distinguishable.
strings.Приложить старое уведомление как доказат: Attach the old notice as proof that a different support is sound.
strings.Приёмная органа исполнительной власти Мо: Reception office of a Moscow executive authority
strings.Проверить условия и представить материал: Check the conditions and submit materials to the authorised official: the right to decide is not an automatic duty of every employee.
strings.Проверьте предмет и пределы ранее принят: Check the subject and limits of the earlier decision.
strings.Решение о безосновательности очередного: A manager or an official specified by law may decide that the further appeal is unfounded and end correspondence. No decision has been made. Your workstation is for registration and preparation of materials and does not carry this power.
strings.Решение принимает уполномоченное лицо пр: An authorised official makes the decision when all conditions are met, and the citizen is notified. Termination concerns the issue, not all future appeals.
strings.Сначала установите событие и единицы счё: First identify the starting event and counting units, then find the exact date. The calendar does not choose the applicable law for you.
strings.Сохранить решение и его предмет, не расп: Preserve the decision and its subject without extending it to new issues
strings.Удалить новое сообщение из-за ранее прин: Delete the new report because of the earlier decision.
strings.Удалить письмо автоматически без решения: Automatically delete the letter without a decision or notice.
strings.Условия для рассмотрения вопроса о прекр: The conditions to consider ending correspondence are present, but termination itself is not automatic.
strings.Условия отсутствия новых доводов и прежн: The materials establish the absence of new arguments and the earlier substantive responses. Mechanically counting registration notices does not replace a decision.
strings.Учебная модель. Принимаете обращение и г: Training model. You receive the appeal and draft referrals to the competent authority and notices. You may not exercise another authority’s powers.
strings.Часть 5 статьи 11 предусматривает право: Part 5 of Article 11 provides for a right of an authorised official and notification, not automatic deletion of repeated letters.
strings.Четвёртое письмо уже считается удалённым: The fourth letter is already deemed deleted by law.
strings.Число прежних ответов даёт бессрочный за: The number of previous responses permanently bans every appeal from the citizen.
strings.Что установлено и что ещё не следует из: What is established, and what does not yet follow from the materials?
